result.summary: Wrote docs/business-plan/README.md: 15 required ## headings exactly and in order, one # title. Recommended order (owner decides): (1) agent pipeline — test, not build: mentor's written consent first, then 10 conversations (assumption) with KZ engineering leads testing a self-installed kit that needs no access to their code; (2) Pixel Office in parallel — price page with prepayment, no product code, only truthful records (R2); (3) KPP only if an integrator partner provides a site, real video and a named payer — not solo. Key numbers: Pixel Agents 86 755 installs, free, no paid tier; 66% of developers complain of 'almost right' AI output; Kriv AI workshop $5 000; hh.kz 37 'Claude Code' vacancies vs 341 on hh.ru; no packaged 'box carry-out' product with a public price found; WF-06 KPP 11/30. Financial model (table 'Допущения' Д1–Д17, target 300 000 ₸/month is an assumption): Pixel Office needs 82 payers / 4 100 active users; kit needs 9 teams; service needs 5 pilots a year at 1 000 000 ₸; KPP needs 46 cameras via partner plus 128 860,73 ₸ per site; 30-day test costs 59 177 ₸ and 41 h. Unproven: no line has any payment evidence in Kazakhstan; nobody pays for agent visualizers; self-installed pipeline kit has only free analogues; KPP accuracy on real video unmeasured; payment acceptance and taxes are gaps. Kill criteria: Pixel Office <3 prepayments at >=300 visitors in 30 days; pipeline <2 of 10 companies pay/sign for the self-installed form (or mentor says no); KPP no partner with site+video+payer in 30 days, pilot <80% catch on 100 labelled passages or >5 false alarms/day. WF-06: plan does not overturn quizzes 21 : Sai 20; by payment evidence quizzes are not weaker than any line; advice — run this plan's 30 days since the owner now asks for 'with agents', fall back to quizzes then Sai; owner decides. [образец] separated (method vs owner's own Sai work); mentor consent in Риски and Решения владельца; [образец] never presented as the owner's product.
